name: Main Gates
shortDescription: Where every visit to the Estate begins, and where the core household gathers for royal announcements.
notes: wagglesworth_estate_royal_quartet is captioned "core cast at estate gates" in the source manifest — a direct match, not a guess.

name: Rose Garden
shortDescription: The outdoor garden where the Ladies-in-Waiting take tea and Lady Isla sings.
notes: Episode One's outdoor tea and Lady Isla's Episode Two song are both set here per the story text; distinct from the Secret Garden below.

name: Secret Garden
shortDescription: A hidden corner of the grounds at the center of the Royal Summer mystery — a bare circle where flowers will not grow, a silver bell, and a forgotten music box.
notes: Matches Episode Two's synopsis closely. A fourth image from the same source folder, a "locket mystery" picture, is held out of this location's gallery — see DECISIONS_AND_GAPS.md, the word "locket" appears nowhere in the story text.

name: Hidden Ballroom
shortDescription: A long-sealed ballroom behind a secret portrait, discovered and restored across Episodes Four through Six.
notes: This art genuinely spans three episodes rather than one — see DECISIONS_AND_GAPS.md — so it lives here at the location level rather than being forced into a single episode's passage.

name: Grand Ballroom
shortDescription: The restored Hidden Ballroom, opened for the Enchanted Silver Rose Ball in Episode Six.
notes: Episode Five's synopsis describes the hidden ballroom being restored and the ball announced there; Episode Six is the ball itself. The story text supports this being the same space, not two separate rooms — needs Barb's confirmation to state as fact.

name: Pool / Cabana
shortDescription: Where the Baroness and Tilly relax during the Ladies-in-Waiting's home leave.

name: Baroness's Rooms
shortDescription: The Baroness's private chambers, including her vanity.

name: High Tea Room
shortDescription: Where the household gathers indoors for tea and gossip.

name: Grand Drawing Room
shortDescription: A formal room of the Estate, reserved for future stories and artwork.
notes: No image in either archive is clearly identifiable as this room specifically. Left without art rather than guessed — a genuinely empty, schema-ready location, per the design document's future-expansion model.
